等式两边同时关于$x,y$求导，得

$3x^2+3z^2z_x-3yz-3xyz_x=0,\quad 3y^2+3z^2z_y-3xz-3xyz_y=0,$

得到$\quad z_x=\frac{yz-x^2}{z^2-xy},\quad z_y=\frac{xz-y^2}{z^2-xy},$

则全微分为$dz=\frac{1}{z^2-xy}\left[(yz-x^2)dx+(xz-y^2)dy\right].$
